title: Mastering the Game of Go with Deep Neural Networks and Tree Search (AlphaGo)
description: Beat world champion Go player. First superhuman performance in a game considered too complex for AI. Policy network + value network + MCTS = the AlphaGo paradigm.
authors: Silver, Huang, Maddison, Guez, Sifre, van den Driessche, Schrittwieser, et al.
